recent.text: Pistons announce Jalen Duren has been cleared to begin on-court activity and will be re-evaluated again in two weeks. He suffered a right hamstring strain on Oct. 23, meaning he will miss at least a month total.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Isaiah Joe has been ruled out tomorrow. Jalen Duren is also out, but an update on his status should come sometime this weekend
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Isaiah Joe getting shots up after practice. Nearing his return https://t.co/tlF5Mm1hfd
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: The Pistons are going through growing pains on offense. Jalen Duren’s return will address most of them https://t.co/0RMPVezmiG
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Practice just ended, and Jalen Duren’s here working with trainers https://t.co/fpZVcacU64
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Duncan Robinson's free throw rate is way up. I asked him why. "(I'm) trying to be a little bit more tactful about getting to the line and using the way defenses are playing me aggressively – grabbing, holding and giving the refs opportunities to see it." https://t.co/gIK4bRe7fa
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: FINAL: Sixers 112, Pistons 106. Pistons trailed by 17 midway through the 2nd and couldn’t get back in it despite cutting it to four late. They fall to 6-2 overall. Sixers take the lead for No. 1 in the East. Robinson: 27 pts Cunningham: 26 pts, 11 assts Thompson: 11 pts, 17 rebs
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Robinson is 7-11 from 3. He's hit at least five 3-pointers in five of eight games this season
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Pistons are on an 11-2 run after the 3 from Huerter. Back within single digits, 95-86
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: End of 3: Sixers 91, Pistons 75. They just have not had it offensively tonight and definitely miss Duren’s size and gravity. Cunningham: 20 pts, 6 assts Robinson: 20 pts
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Robinson's just been tremendous this season.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Robinson's doing his best to fill the "secondary scorer" void. Leading the Pistons with 17 points after knocking down his fifth 3 of the night
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Dean Wade is one of the best Cade defenders in the league. Especially with Duren out, this isn't a team the Pistons can survive an off offensive night against.
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Halftime: Sixers 56, Pistons 42. Offense has been rough, Pistons are shooting 37.2% overall and 4-17 from 3. Definitely feeling Duren’s absence. Robinson: 11 pts Cunningham: 9 pts, 5 rebs, 4 assts Jaylen Brown: 23 pts (8-12 overall)
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Three fouls on Collins. Early foul trouble has become a recurring issue
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: End of 1: Sixers 29, Pistons 21. Brown hit a deep 3 at the buzzer. Pistons started as though they were shot out of a rocket but cooled off, shooting 36.4% (8-22) overall. Robinson: 6 pts Cunningham: 4 pts, 3 assts
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: Huerter's shooting 39.3% from 3 (11-28) after that make. He's hit six of his last 11
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II
